name: Nadine Walks
description:
Hi everyone, I'm Nadine! In 2014, I walked 500-miles across Spain on the Camino Francés, and I was hooked. Hooked on the Camino, hooked on walking, hooked on long-distance trails. 

I've walked in France and Spain and Portugal and England and Scotland, and have a long list of walks around the world that I'd like to check off. Since that first long walk I've been blogging at nadinewalks.com, and have now started putting together videos- another way to share the stories of my trails.  

Happy to have you here, and please subscribe to follow my walking adventures!
